entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I... I think I need to return something? I bought these spin class shoes a while ago and I'm just so confused by them.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The email is m.valenti@email.com.

Thank you, Maria. I see your account here. You're calling about the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?

I don't know, honestly. I've worn them a few times and they just hurt my feet so much. I keep getting terrible blisters. I read the instructions about adjusting the cleats, but it's all very overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I think I just want to get a refund at this point.
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check your purchase date to see what our options are. One moment.
Okay, thank you. It just feels like I'm doing something wrong but I don't know what.
I understand. Okay, I see the order was delivered about 75 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? It's that simple? I was so worried it was too late. I just couldn't figure out the website policy.

Not a problem at all, Maria. I'm happy to help. I am processing the return authorization for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's a relief. Thank you so much, Alex!

You're very welcome. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty and to help you find a better pair of cycling shoes, I've added a 15% credit to your account for your next purchase. We also offer complimentary virtual fitting sessions if you'd like to ensure a perfect fit next time.
That's so nice of you! A virtual fitting sounds great, actually. Thank you for making this so easy.
It's my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
